grounding: projects have only a test command; R8 lists gates by hand

[1/2] Gate DTO + per-stack gate detection (python ruff/mypy when configured, node package scripts lint/typecheck/build, go vet) + project.json gates override (null disables) + run_gates with injected runner + aikit check <name> (secret scan always last, terse failure tails, exit 1 on any failure or no test gate); unit + integration tests; [2/2] R8 names python aikit.py check <name> as the project Phase 4 gate; status prints it; README/knowledge/ADR

impact_assessment.why: a project's Phase 4 is a hand-assembled list; lint, type and build checks a project configures are never run
impact_assessment.benefits: one command per project runs every check its own config declares, same for every host
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new check command and project.json gates key; dependency: none (runs the project's own tools); concurrency: gates run sequentially in the project dir; state: optional gates key, schema unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: detection only from config the project already has; override and disable via gates; runner injected for unit tests; timeouts and closed stdin on every gate

[1/5] plan: apply guidelines, self-checking and self-fixing to built projects

impact_assessment.why: Ensure AIKit guidelines that keep its own code correct also apply to projects it builds (anti-lazy, architecture, ADR register, workspace hygiene), closing the provider delegation gap and making the kit capable, self-checking, and self-fixing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Projects built by AIKit are guarded by the exact same quality and architectural invariants as AIKit itself; built-in guidelines gate catches stubs, junk-drawers, and broken ADRs; aikit fix self-heals project scaffolding and cleans stale buffers; projects receive AGENTS.md guidelines automatically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: resolve_gates adds guidelines gate before secrets; dependency: zero external dependencies, pure stdlib; concurrency: gate runs under supervised() with whole-tree timeout kill; state: write_memory never overwrites existing project memory or AGENTS.md
impact_assessment.mitigation: Existing tests updated to expect guidelines gate; resolve_gates handles polyglot and Python projects gracefully; all unit tests stay under 1s.
